dedupe_keys.name: karte der bundeswasserstraßen 1 500 000 wasser und schifffahrtsdirektion west

description: Karte der Bundeswasserstraßen 1 : 500 000 - Wasser- und Schifffahrtsdirektion West is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The map of federal waterways 1: 500 000 serves as an overview within a larger neighbourhood in the administrative area of the Water and Shipping Directorate West. This is based on raster data from Digital Topographic Map 1: 500 000 (DTK500, unreferenced PDF file). Submission WSVintern as PDF file. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Map of Federal Waterways 1 : 500,000 - Water and Shipping Directorate West" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Sperrwerke, wsv_topic_code:DBWK500, Fahrwasser, Datteln-Hamm-Kanal, Dortmund-Ems-Kanal, Unterhaltung. The listing shows 2007-02-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
